comments.text: The spec's Data model says 'No relationships. No rules beyond the table' and the design claims to be 'Modelled exactly as the spec's Data model bean block', yet it adds a `by_captured_at` index the spec never mentions. The index is harmless and plausibly serves the standard browse screen, but per the design's own framing it should be surfaced as a deliberate design addition (one clause: 'index added beyond the bean block to support newest-first browsing') or dropped — otherwise a reviewer comparing the migration against the spec's bean block sees an unexplained index.
